raw.headline: Household has only 8 hours backup against an 80-hour outage risk.
raw.decision: Leave for a powered location before the storm arrives because 8 hours backup is insufficient for the expected 80-hour outage.

items.requirement: Keep internal and external batteries fully charged before an outage.
items.gap: Planned backup of 8 hours is far less than the 80-hour outage record.
actions: Test the ventilator on battery power monthly.

items.requirement: Never operate the portable generator inside enclosed spaces.
items.gap: Generator use in the garage creates deadly carbon monoxide risk.
actions: Run the generator only outdoors, away from windows.
Install a carbon monoxide detector in the garage.
Check fuel and oil levels before each use.

missing.why: To provide safe backup power without carbon monoxide risk indoors.
missing.action: Purchase and place an approved outdoor generator.

event.name: Winter Storm Uri
event.harm: 25 deaths from interrupted dialysis or oxygen, frozen devices and medication, or power loss on life-sustaining equipment; 19 carbon monoxide deaths (Texas DSHS, Dec 2021).

items.label: ResMed Astral
facts: Internal battery about 8 h typical, over 4 h worst case.
1 external battery(ies): 8 h each in typical use, two at most.
items.requirement: Keep internal and external batteries fully charged before an outage.
items.gap: Planned backup of 8 hours is far less than the 80-hour outage record.

items.label: Portable generator
facts: Exhaust carbon monoxide builds up in enclosed spaces, a garage included.
items.requirement: Never operate the portable generator inside enclosed spaces.
items.gap: Generator use in the garage creates deadly carbon monoxide risk.
actions: Run the generator only outdoors, away from windows.
Install a carbon monoxide detector in the garage.
Check fuel and oil levels before each use.
